label: build F2 2/4
result:
Unit 2 of F2 (the shell chrome) is built and committed on `v2/f2`. The branch is detached and the server on 8012 is stopped. Nothing was pushed or merged. `PYTHONPATH=. python3 server/test_flow.py` prints "all good".

Your relayed message was "what should i tell my oother guy". The list under "Needed from other owners" is what to pass on to whoever owns those files.

**Commits (on top of unit 1's five)**
- `116514c` api_shell: this commits the predecessor's uncommitted edit. It adds the full email for the account-menu header and an empty `plan.next_test` slot for S7 to fill.
- `db90fde` ui.js: the shell chrome on every page.
- `3b7898d` ui.js: fixes. The rail peek now closes when the pointer leaves, the sidebar card's streak fits, and the time-box chips are readable on tile backgrounds.
- `ff6952e` ui.js: when `/api/shell` fails, Up next and the Today card are hidden and the nav still works. A retired code leaves nothing of that student on screen.
- `317ee8c` ui.js: every Now strip repaints with the shell data and when the layout changes.

**What's built, all in `web/assets/ui.js`**
- **Sidebar, rail and overlay:**
  - The nine R1 items: Today, Practice, Review, Words, Tests, Plan / Results, Compete, Profile. There is no Class item.
  - The rail is collapsed with `[` or the toggle and remembered in `satf.rail`. Between 760 and 1099px wide the rail opens the full sidebar over a scrim.
  - The rail peeks the full sidebar after a 400 ms pointer rest or while `[` is held. On the rail, metas become a count bubble or a dot, and tooltips give the name, the meta and the shortcut.
- **Section mapping:** mistakes lights Review, challenge lights Compete, report lights Results, diagnostic lights Tests, and me, settings and signin light Profile.
- **Nav metas, all from `/api/shell`:**
  - Today shows 12/28 or Done, with a progress ring on the rail.
  - Practice and Tests show a Resume chip; Tests also shows Test day.
  - Review shows "6 due · 25 open", Words "12 due", Results New, Compete New / Resume / #rank, and Profile the week goals.
  - Plan shows its day kind or the next test day ("Test Fri").
- **Today card:** the streak with one outlined flame per spare day, study time, the registration line, closing contests and the exam footer. The figures open their working through the kit's `[data-fact]`.
- **Up next:** Start, the `G N` key, the › popover with Not today and time-box chips, and `?next=1`. It appears in the tall sidebar, the Now strip, the rail's play button and the menu sheet.
- **Section bar:** `UI.sections` with scroll-spy. On every page a sticky "Up next · Start" appears once the Now strip has scrolled away.
- **Account menu:**
  - Built on the kit's `UI.menu`. The header has no focusable parts, and Display is a real `role=group` holding Dark theme and Large text checkboxes and Keyboard shortcuts.
  - It also has the inbox rows, the save callout, students on a family device, and Sign in another device.
  - Signing out a saved account shows "Signed out · Undo" for 8 s. A shared computer signs out at once. An unsaved device gets the "Leave this device" dialog.
- **Phone:**
  - The top bar has the Review chip, the streak, Quick and the avatar with an unread count or a dot.
  - The 5 tabs have dots, a grip, 450 ms hold menus and the "Hold a tab for shortcuts" hint.
  - The menu sheet has a footer that is always visible: Review, Words, Compete and Quick.
- **Loaded on first use:** `UI.quick`, `UI.palette` and `UI.report` load `quick.js`, `palette.js` and `report.js` when first called. `?feedback` works on any page.
- **Exports:** `UI.NAV`, `SECTION`, `nowStrip`, `sections`, `menuSheet`, `accountMenu`, `signOut`.

**Verified in headless Chromium**
- The U26 height budget passes at 1366×657, 1440×790, 1280×900, 1280×500 and 1920×1100. At 1366×470 the active item stays in view.
- The phone checks pass at 390 and 360: no sideways scroll, the grip opens the sheet, and holding Practice lists Log a mistake.
- Account-menu keyboard, collapse and rail, and the sign-out flows all work.
- Every page loads at 1280 and 390, light and dark, for a new and a seeded learner, with no console errors.

**Left undone**
- `server/next.py` (Up next's queue) is F2's but not in my file list. Until it exists the Up next block stays hidden, and opening the › popover calls `GET /api/next`, which 404s.
- "Continue on your phone" (G12) needs `qr.js` (unit 3) and S1's pairing endpoints.
- `UI.autoSheet` (the week sheet and welcome-back), the achievement and reply toasts, and the other banners belong to unit 3.
- README "serving layer" notes and `web/sw.js` are outside my files.

**Needed from other owners**
- **F1 (`kit.js`):** `UI.tooltip` needs a "to the right" placement for rail tooltips; right now they show below-centred. A native `role=group` in `UI.menu` would let me drop my wrapper code.
- **S1:**
  - `GET /api/me/feed?unread=1&limit=3`, `POST /api/me/feed/seen` and `/api/levers`.
  - `DELETE /api/devices/this`, which Sign out already sends.
  - The `/help/`, `/me/settings/`, `/signin/` and `/link/` pages.
- **S7:** `plan.next_test`, `today.done`, and `UI.plan.doneOf`. Until then ui.js uses the plan rule and questions ≥ goal.
- **S8:** the `compete` shell part's `closing_soon` items with a title, a closing time label and a link (`{title, when, href}`).
- **Unit 3:** `quick.js` and `palette.js` must add `UI.quick` / `UI.palette` with `Object.assign`; ui.js loads them on first call. The storage-blocked banner is already switched to `UI.banner('storage', …)`.
- **Pages still to be built:** `/review/`, `/words/` and `/compete/` show the 404 page (which has the shell) until S10, S9 and S8 land.
